description: datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) relies on system wall-clock time rather than a monotonic clock. If system time is adjusted backward by NTP daemons (e.g., systemd-timesyncd, chronyd) between execution rounds, or if concurrent worker processes write receipts to receipts_dir without file-level locking, newly written receipt timestamps will regress relative to earlier rounds. When run_verify subsequently reads these receipt files from disk, ts != sorted(ts) will evaluate to True and cause runtime verification failures ('timestamps not monotonic'). Smoke test: Execute sequential rounds while simulating negative NTP clock adjustments and concurrent process writes, then execute run_verify to ensure file side effects stay strictly monotonic on disk.
